name: 预算执行核查
description: 核查预算余额，防止超预算支出
statement: SELECT b.budget_no, b.budget_name, b.total_amount AS budget_amount, SUM(e.total_amount) AS expense_amount, b.total_amount - SUM(e.total_amount) AS remain FROM 预算主表 b LEFT JOIN 报销主表 e ON b.budget_no = e.budget_no GROUP BY b.budget_no
